name: Naomi Shelton
description: '''Naomi Davis Shelton''' (born '''Naomi Virginia Davis'''; October 14, 1942 – February 17, 2021) was an American [[gospel music|gospel]], [[blues]], [[funk]], and [[soul music|soul]] musician, who performed [[traditional black gospel]], [[deep funk]], [[northern soul]] and [[rhythm and blues]] styles of music. She started her music career in 1958, and in 1999 she formed the group Naomi Shelton & the Gospel Queens.
